title: libpod: add the syslog log driver
body:
Forward container output with --log-driver syslog, including remote delivery via --log-opt syslog-address and syslog-facility. Pass these to conmon v3 as --log-driver and --log-driver-opt. podman logs cannot read the forwarded output back.

Fixes: #28779

```release-note
Add support for the `syslog` logging driver with conmon-v3. Container logs can now be forwarded to local or remote syslog servers using `--log-driver syslog`, with configurable address, facility, and tag options. Logs forwarded to syslog are not available through `podman logs`.
```

comments.body: I'm marking this as draft until new conmon-v3 with support for syslog hits rawhide, but the code is ready for review otherwise. It's just the tests will fail, because rawhide contains conmon-v3 without syslog support.
